answer: A citation bond stops fake identities. Each agent locks a 70-credit sable bond and files one work citing three prior works from the oasis. The karst ledger caps each cited work at five citations an epoch, key-bound to the filer. Auditors replay the chain: a reused or mismatched citation burns the bond. Fees start at 30, up 6 per fake, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,097,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 30 once and reclaim it after a clean epoch.
